welcome.subject: Welcome to TalentIQ!
welcome.template:
Hey {{name}} Welcome to TalentIQ. 
  here's your OTP code {{otp}}

accountRejected.subject: Account Rejected
accountRejected.template: Dear {{name}}, your account has been rejected for the following reason: {{rejectionReason}}

emailVerificationOtp.subject: Your TalentIQ verification code
emailVerificationOtp.template:
Verify your email

Hi {{name}},

Use this code to verify your TalentIQ account:

{{otp}}

The code expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

If you didn't create a TalentIQ account, you can ignore this email.

emailVerified.subject: Welcome to TalentIQ!
emailVerified.template:
Welcome to TalentIQ

Hi {{name}},

Your email has been verified. You can now sign in and start screening candidates.

passwordResetOtp.subject: Your TalentIQ password reset code
passwordResetOtp.template:
Reset your password

Hi {{name}},

Use this code to reset your TalentIQ password:

{{otp}}

The code expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

If you didn't request a password reset, you can ignore this email. Your password won't change.

passwordChanged.subject: Your TalentIQ password was changed
passwordChanged.template:
Password changed

Hi {{name}},

Your TalentIQ password was just changed. You can now sign in with your new password.

If you didn't make this change, reset your password immediately and contact your workspace administrator.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify Your Email Address
verifyEmail.template:
Hello {{name}},

Please verify your email address by clicking here. This link will expire in 24 hours.

accountVerificationSubmitted.subject: Account Verification Submitted
accountVerificationSubmitted.template: Dear {{name}}, Your account has been submitted for verification. You'll be notified once it's verified.
